# GitHub Traffic Analytics Dashboard

> Free, open-source dashboard that stores GitHub repository traffic (views, clones, referrers, stars) permanently, beyond GitHub's 14-day limit. Public repositories only, no login. Data through 2026-11-25, updated 2026-11-26.

## Pages
- [Dashboard](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/): overview, trends, sources, repositories, insights, links, comments
- [Methodology](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/methodology/): data source, definitions, formulas, limitations
- [FAQ](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/faq/): answers about GitHub traffic data, clones, unique visitors, limits
- [Guide: keep GitHub traffic beyond 14 days](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/guides/keep-github-traffic-history/): step-by-step with code
- [Guide: GitHub traffic API reference](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/guides/github-traffic-api-reference/): endpoints, fields, limits
- [Weekly reports](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/reports/): 3 completed weeks
- [All repositories](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/repositories/): descriptions, languages, stars, traffic
- [Status](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/status/): data freshness and collection run history
- [Optimizer](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/optimizer/): AI metadata optimizer: rules, safety checks, change log
- [Changelog](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/changelog/): release notes
- [Open data](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/data/): JSON, CSV and badge files
- [About](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/about/): maintainer, purpose, editorial policy
- [Privacy](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/privacy/): no cookies or tracking
- [Source code](https://github.com/musman550/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard): MIT licensed

## Data
- [summary.json](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/data/summary.json): aggregated statistics, repository table, insights
- [series.json](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/data/series.json): daily views and clones per repository
- [repos.csv](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/data/repos.csv) and [daily.csv](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/data/daily.csv)
- [Atom feed](https://musman550.github.io/github-traffic-analytics-dashboard/feed.xml): weekly reports

## Key facts
- Tracked public repositories: 308
- Last 30 days: 564 views, 13200 clones. Stars: 5. Forks: 0.
- Source of data: GitHub REST API traffic endpoints (https://docs.github.com/rest/metrics/traffic)
- GitHub keeps only 14 days of traffic and the top 10 referrers/paths; this project stores every day.
